domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report domestic-sales split could be retrieved: Tofler company page returned 404, Zauba Corp returned HTTP 403, and web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable (connection refused) throughout, so no domestic-supply record was located. This is a data-access gap, not a finding of absence — the company's own site (theglobalgreencompany.com) did not resolve.
note: Exporter identity is solid and factual, not merely declared: recurring India-origin shipments of pickled gherkins/relish under HS 20011000 from Bangalore ICD, Tondiapeta ICD, Chennai Sea and Hyderabad ICD to Savannah/Houston (US), Sydney (Australia), with named consignees Walmart Inc, Sam's Club, Global Green USA Ltd, Coles and Loblaws, and B/L numbers on every row. Declared HS 200110 matches the observed 20011000 — no correction needed. Note the two ImportKey slugs describe the same group from two angles (India export records vs US import records) and the US-side rows carry HS 230302, which is a US tariff-schedule code, not a contradiction of the Indian 20011000. Domestic (India-market) supply is unverified: null, not invented. Revenue/export volume figures are not public on the free pages — null. No rejection grounds: the entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-28.
